collection.title: SsangYong Korando Korando 2019 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ssangyong Korando 2019 - 2023 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this model, simply clickon the Rear Blades Tab below.
